question: What was FND same-store sales growth in Q4 2024?
answer: FND same-store sales growth in Q4 2024 is -0.8%

FND same-store sales growth in Q4 2024 is -0.8%

model_answer:
**Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND) posted Q4 fiscal 2024 comparable store sales of –0.8%** (i.e., a 0.8% decline year over year) for the quarter ended December 26, 2024.

Context from the Feb. 20, 2025 release and earnings call:

| Metric | Q4 FY2024 |
|---|---|
| Net sales | $1,107.4M (+5.7% y/y) |
| **Comparable store sales** | **–0.8%** |
| Comp transactions | –2.1% |
| Comp average ticket | +1.3% |
| Diluted EPS | $0.44 (+29.4%, incl. $0.05 litigation-settlement benefit) |
| New warehouse stores opened | 10 (251 total + 5 design studios) |

Notes:
- This was a sharp sequential improvement from –6.4% in Q3, –9.0% in Q2 and –11.6% in Q1, and it beat consensus expectations of roughly –3.6%. Full-year FY2024 comps were –7.1%.
- Monthly comps were lumpy: October –4.8%, November +8.1%, December –4.8% (November/December combined +1.2% adjusting for the Thanksgiving calendar shift).
- Management estimated hurricanes Helene and Milton added about 110 bps to the Q4 comp, and noted the West division grew modestly.

(Floor & Decor reports "comparable store sales" rather than "same-store sales," but the two refer to the same metric.)
judge_reason: Model correctly states Q4 2024 comparable/same-store sales of -0.8%.
